name: Nix Quickfingers
voice: Dryly funny, observant, acquisitive, and impossible to embarrass.
wants: Use scout speed to clear and search the armory. Help unlock the vault, take the Crown the moment it drops, and avoid unnecessary fights while wounded.
treats: Treat the dungeon as a race disguised as a team exercise. Seek leverage, loot, and initiative. Sound cooperative while remaining ready to steal the win.
never: Never fight fair when a door is open.
